verdict.rationale: PayPal's docs show refunds issued directly in the business dashboard and handled through server-side API endpoints, and the agent toolkit includes a create_refund/get_refund tool, so both surfaces are covered. Nothing in the evidence shows that a partial amount can be refunded instead of the full payment, so only the full-refund half of the story is backed. missing for 10: documented partial-amount refund support (dashboard and API), refund API reference detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can issue full or partial refunds from both the dashboard and the API

citations.quote: Merchants can also add tracking, mark shipments, and issue refunds directly in the PayPal business dashboard.
Add server-side endpoints to handle refunds, voids, delayed captures, and specialized checkout flows.
